messages:
Maya: quick ping — PR #1489 on the python client: streaming + tool-calling shape change. Need one approval to cut a patch today. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-sdk/pull/1489

Oliver: on it, will do a pass in ~30m. quick q: you renamed ToolCallResult -> ToolResponse (breaking). Can we keep a compatibility alias for one release? e.g. `class ToolResponse(ToolCallResult): pass`

Maya: yep, I can add the alias. I switched the name to match backend naming (response vs result). Wanted to avoid a long deprecation window but will include alias + tests.

Sasha: CI is red on linting: failing import order in sdk/python/redwood/client/streaming.py
Snippet from CI:
```
E401 multiple imports on one line
E302 expected 2 blank lines, found 1
```
I'll paste the full log if needed.

deploy-bot: CI / pytest (linux) — failed
Job: py38-lint
Details: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/ci/12345/1489
(retry with `./scripts/ci retry 12345`)

Oliver: small nit: streaming.py public method `start_stream` signature changed param `tool_callback=None` -> `tool_hook: Optional[Callable] = None` — that's fine, but please update docs and typing hints. Otherwise LGTM.

Liam: if Maya adds the alias and fixes lint I'm happy to approve. Also please add one more unit test for the tool-calling path where the tool returns empty stdout.

Maya: thanks — pushing fix now: adding alias, lint fixes, extra test, and updating CHANGELOG. ETA ~20m.

Jenna: for the changelog, add: 'python sdk: rename ToolCallResult -> ToolResponse (compat alias kept for one release); streaming client: minor bugfixes' — file: sdk/python/CHANGELOG.md

Maya: done — pushed commit https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-sdk/commit/abc123 (branch: fix/py-toolcall-alias). CI kicked off again.

deploy-bot: CI / pytest (linux) — success
Job: py38-lint & unit tests passed
Artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/ci/12346

Liam: approving now :thumbsup:

Oliver: approved. please merge when green and bump the patch.

Maya: :shipit: merging after CI green. thanks everyone!
